head: codex/writer-failure-diagnostics-20261012
title: fix: retain safe writer failure evidence in recovery receipts
body:
Three actual terminal recovery roles (38186177460, 38186177480, 38186177424) failed at their first signed READ_FAILED_ASSURANCE_TERMINAL_CONTEXT invocation. The client discarded the Lambda response before the existing HOLD artifact could distinguish a writer contract rejection, signature failure, AWS error or partial reservation state.

Preserve bounded status/FunctionError, allowlisted error type and fixed writer/AWS error code, and response SHA256 in the existing recovery HOLD receipt. Raw response, message, stack, payload, signature and environment are never retained. The existing failure rejection, one invocation, no retry, private response cleanup and authority/HOLD boundaries remain enforced. CLI invocation errors also become safe diagnostic UNKNOWN failures. No IAM, workflow trigger, writer deployment or reservation consumption changes.

Validation: 208 related regression/negative tests passed. Independent Red Team21 client/integration tests passed, including actual CLI catch/HOLD artifact/nonzero exit, malformed/oversized/symlink rejection, single invoke and secret non-disclosure. Exact-head native CI is pending. These are local tests, not live AWS repair evidence.

The deployed writer CodeSha256, real error response and consistent original row remain unverified. Current source capsule role/schema tests passed; deployed-version mismatch is not established as sole cause. Natural clock Assurance38186224330 had two GITHUB_HTTP_403 failures and remains rejected by the terminal-only recovery allowlist. Original2655 terminal remains unresolved; no retry/reconsume, new manual runtime dispatch, deployment or business generation is requested. This is the one bounded diagnostic correction in the existing closure mission; prior2663 is already merged and is not repeated.

Rollback: revert this bounded diagnostic delta. autonomous_effect=preserve evidence for natural recovery without manual retry; global_effect=keep existing producer scope; irreplaceable_value_effect=preserve original reservation identity and failure lineage; transparency_effect=retain safe actual failure facts without inferred success. Production/Public/G5/provider HOLD.
